sign_correction.interpretation: Positive means the five-parameter training-fitted null comparator scores WORSE on held-out data than the intercept-refitted true backbone: a finite-sample overfitting loss, not an estimation gain.

definitions.partial_oracle_a: True attenuation on each history's fitted training null backbone with a scalar intercept refit on training data.
definitions.partial_oracle_b: True attenuation fixed; five nuisance-backbone parameters refit on training data from five starts (fitted true-backbone, intercept-refitted, true generating backbone and two neutral interior starts).
definitions.partial_oracle_c: True generating backbone, and its intercept-refitted version, combined with each history's fitted (eta, log ell, log psi); the held-out loss isolates attenuation-estimation error.
